svg.title: R2DBC SoftDelete Transaction Flow
svg.desc: Sequence diagram rebuilt from SoftDeletedR2dbcRepository source, exposed-r2dbc README usage, and soft-delete repository tests.
svg.text: Soft-delete methods update the isDeleted flag, while read helpers add active/deleted predicates before mapping rows.

g.text: softDeleteById and restoreById return Unit; bulk methods return affected-row counts; active/deleted readers add isDeleted predicates.
